Procedure: tighten one side to a 1.0–1.5 mm gap, the other side to 4.0 N·m ±0.5, then the first side to 4.0 N·m and check equal gaps. Clamp cross-section and lug shape are representative; the two-split, two-sided design is documented.

facts: Joint sizes: J0–J2 (base, shoulder, elbow) size 3; J3–J5 (wrists) size 1 (UR joint-compatibility article).
Torque limits 150 N·m (J0–J2) and 28 N·m (J3–J5); ±360° except elbow ±180° (ur_description, UR5e manual).

Joint connections (UR torque table): base through elbow counterpart → lower arm use a two-piece clamp, 4 mm hex key, 4.0 N·m; lower arm → wrist 1 through wrist 3 → tool use M3 Torx TX10 screws, 1.3 N·m (0.9 N·m countersunk).
Base: four M8 class 8.8 bolts at 20 N·m in Ø8.4 holes with Ø13.5 counterbores on Ø132 (measured in the official mesh); two Ø8 F8 pin holes.
Tool flange EN ISO 9409-1-50-4-M6: 4 × M6 on Ø50, Ø31.5 H7 bore, Ø6 H7 pin hole, measured in the official wrist-3 mesh. Tool screws 8 N·m, class 8.8.
